description: LRUCache get(key) retrieves value but does not move key to the most-recently-used position.

tests.test_cache.py:
from cache import LRUCache

def test_missing_key():
    # Passes before fix
    c = LRUCache(2)
    assert c.get('missing') == -1

def test_basic_put_get():
    # Passes before fix
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put('a', 1)
    assert c.get('a') == 1

def test_eviction_order():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put('a', 1)
    c.put('b', 2)
    # Access 'a', making 'b' the least recently used
    assert c.get('a') == 1
    # Put 'c', should evict 'b'
    c.put('c', 3)
    assert c.get('b') == -1
    assert c.get('a') == 1
    assert c.get('c') == 3
